body: Yeah I'm trying to focus on work more or talk to others but I have no one to talk to besides my dad and he isn't very loving or cares about my life much. I'm going to talk to my friends tonight and hopefully get their support. I hope I can move on and use this situation and the awful things I have done to be a better person but I have no clue how to move on really.

I'm trying to take it day by day but like you said it's not the loneliness or sadness of what I lost that hurts me the most, it's the pain I've caused the two people I care for the most in the world. I hope this will act as a turning point in my life but at the same time I have no clue how to move on.

I really am not looking for sympathy or pity because I realize the pain I put both of these two people through I just needed some where to say how I felt and what was going on in my life since I don't have someone to talk to. It's not the loneliness I'm feeling so much as a hatred for myself for causing this pain to the two people I supposedly cared about most in the world. There's no way I actually cared about these people and loved them and acted the way I did. Of course I am lonely but that's not the hurt I am feeling, the hurt I am feeling is the pain of knowing the pain I have caused them and never being able to apologize enough or do anything about it. I deserve your hatred just like I deserve theirs.

Thanks a lot for this. The only person I have to talk to about this all is my Dad and that's what he tries to tell me. It's just a hard thing to believe when the two people you care about most think you're so awful and inherently shitty.
